game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto, a grotto of glowing crystals: the spelunker must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the wooden door fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto: a grotto of glowing crystals
core_gameplay_loop: In Crystal Grotto, repeat each round: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the wooden door fast. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the size value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the wooden door using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The wooden door reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the wooden door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Doubling Growth
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Doubling Growth' (Week 4 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Crystal Grotto'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Crystal Grotto.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wooden door reached with actions_used <= 15.
